QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Control a SIYI optical pod (ZT30, ZT6, ZR30, ZR10, A8) directly over its own Ethernet link using the SIYI SDK protocol. The ground station must share a network with the camera. Video is configured separately under Video settings.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable SIYI camera control

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ipAddress
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: IP address of the SIYI optical pod. Factory default is 192.168.144.25.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Camera IP address

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: port
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UDP port the SIYI pod listens on for SDK commands. Factory default is 37260.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Camera SDK port

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: secondaryRtspUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: RTSP URL for the ZT30 sub stream shown in the second camera panel. The path varies by camera firmware, so verify it on the installed payload (for example, rtsp://192.168.144.25:8554/video2).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Secondary RTSP URL

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: aiEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Talk to a SIYI AI tracking module on its own Ethernet address. The module is separate hardware between the optical pod and the SIYI link; it recognises and tracks one selected target (person, car, bus, truck).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable SIYI AI tracking module

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: aiIpAddress
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: IP address of the SIYI AI tracking module. Factory default is 192.168.144.60.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: AI module IP address

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: aiPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UDP port the SIYI AI tracking module listens on. Factory default is 37260.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: AI module SDK port

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: aiRtspUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: RTSP stream published by the SIYI AI tracking module. This is the module's own re-encoded feed, separate from the pod's streams, and is where the AI recognition boxes appear. Factory default is rtsp://192.168.144.60:554/video0.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: AI module RTSP URL
